meta.ogTitle: Home Rec — Record what you're hearing
meta.ogDescription: Capture your Mac's audio output as lossless WAV. No drivers. No routing tricks. One click from the menu bar.

hero.sub: Capture whatever your Mac is playing as a lossless WAV. One click. No drivers, no routing, no setup, no account.

app.windowAria: Home Rec app showing a recording in progress with timer at 02:47 and animated waveform

card1.title: Menu bar, always there
card1.desc: Home Rec lives in your menu bar and stays running when you close the window. One click opens a compact popover — waveform, timer, record button. Trigger a recording without switching focus.

card2.title: Lossless WAV, every time
card2.desc: 48kHz stereo PCM. No compression. No codec artifacts. Whatever goes in comes out exactly as it sounded — ready for Ableton, Logic Pro, any DAW, any audio editor, no questions asked.

card3.title: Live waveform feedback
card3.desc: Real-time amplitude visualization confirms audio is actually flowing — not just a blinking dot. The waveform appears in both the popover and the main window so you always know signal is good.

card4.title: Zero setup. Works immediately.
card4.desc: No virtual audio drivers. No loopback routing. No Audio MIDI Setup. Grant the Screen Recording permission once — and that's it. Works on Apple Silicon and Intel without any configuration.

step1.title: Play something
step1.desc: Open any app or website you're working with. Home Rec captures the audio your Mac is playing.

step2.title: Click Record
step2.desc: Hit the red button in the menu bar popover or the main window. Recording starts immediately. The live timer and waveform confirm audio is flowing.

step3.title: Done.
step3.desc: Click Stop. Your WAV file lands on the Desktop with a timestamp filename. Click "Reveal in Finder" and drag it wherever you need it.

perApp.h2:
Record one app.
Leave the rest alone.
perApp.desc: Per-application audio capture built for DJs, producers, and beatmakers. Record just the app you're working in — no Slack pings, no background audio creeping into your mix. Finally.

download.sub: Free now, free always. Built by one person. If Home Rec earns a spot on your Mac, you can buy me a coffee — but it's a gift, not a fee.
